system.description: You have inherited more of your clan's stolen Tzimisce blood than most of your clanmates, becoming something of a throwback to your "parent" clan. You may choose Vicissitude, rather than Dominate, as a clan Discipline. Improving your rating in it, however, is difficult: unless you can find another Tremere both willing and able to teach you Vicissitude's higher levels, you must seek further instruction from the Tzimisce — most likely through coercion.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
